ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly elevated distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation and jagged tissue loss located on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
